summary.text: Jerry W. Stevenson is a Republican member of the Utah Senate representing District 6 in Davis County, appointed in January 2010. His official legislative profile lists his profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Stevenson's listed affiliations include 12 years as Layton City mayor, 8 years on the Layton City Council, and service as a Weber State University trustee and chair of the UTA Rail Committee.
He attended Utah State University and sits on the Executive Appropriations Committee and the Senate Health and Human Services Committee.
